description: Create a post. Can save as draft, schedule for a specific time, or publish immediately. Use the platforms parameter to cross-post the same text to X, Bluesky and LinkedIn in one call. Omitting platforms leaves the targeting to the account auto cross-post setting rather than pinning the post to X.

auto_retweet.description: Enable auto-retweet after posting. X only, ignored on Bluesky and LinkedIn. The post will be retweeted automatically after the specified offset.

auto_retweet_offset_minutes.description: Minutes to wait before auto-retweeting (e.g. 60, 120, 240, 480, 1440). Defaults to 60.

media_urls.description: Array of media URLs (upload first with opentweet_upload_media)

platforms.description: Networks to post to: "x", "bluesky", "linkedin". Pass ["x", "bluesky", "linkedin"] to publish the same content to all three in one call. Any non-empty subset works, so ["linkedin"] posts to LinkedIn only, and an explicit list is always honoured exactly. LinkedIn posts go to the connected personal profile, and a thread goes to LinkedIn as one combined post. Leaving this out is not the same as pinning to X: an unspecified post follows the account auto cross-post setting, which sends it to every connected network when that setting is on. Call opentweet_list_platforms to see what an unspecified post would target. A network the user has not connected is reported as skipped rather than failing the call.

publish_now.description: Set to true to publish immediately instead of saving as draft

scheduled_date.description: ISO 8601 date-time to schedule the tweet (e.g. "2026-03-15T09:00:00Z"). Omit to save as draft.

text.description: Post text content (max 280 characters for free X accounts, up to 25,000 for Premium+; Bluesky caps at 300 characters, LinkedIn at 3,000)

x_account_id.description: Target X account ID (for multi-account users). Omit to use primary account.

name: opentweet_create_tweet
